record.one_liner: Higgsfield provides an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and CLI tool allowing AI agents (like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes) to generate images and videos directly without managing API keys.

auth_methods.quote: Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.

access_test.quote: Do I need an API key? No. Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account. No API keys to manage or configure.

access_ship.quote: Do I need an API key? No. Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account. No API keys to manage or configure.

api_type.quote: 1. Install the CLI: run `npm i -g @higgsfield/cli` . 2. Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens. 3. Install the companion skills: run `npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills`

api_breadth.quote: Once connected, your agent can generate images, create videos, train characters, and browse your creation history, all within a single session.

official_mcp.quote: Higgsfield uses MCP (Model Context Protocol), an open standard that gives AI agents access to external tools.
